generality: Every fixed K>0 and alpha in (0,1).
main_claim: Uniform safety under the frozen oracle and cap forces E_null[T_epsilon] >= n_safe(epsilon)-O(1) on an explicit public finite-support null family. Consequently no fixed fractional uniform null-family saving rho<1 is possible.
safety_used: Only zeta=1: t=ceil(exp((K+1)/epsilon)); the required all-zeta safety implies this.
public_null_family: m=n_safe^3 ordinary labels and m rare labels, complete q table and symmetric Q pairing each ordinary label with its rare partner; all null raw weights equal 1 and the supplied K stays positive.
finite_tradeoff: For the parameterized admitted family in RESULT.txt, max_S TV(mu_S C_S^t,pi_S) >= ((1-alpha)/4)*(1-v)^(t-1)*(b^(E_null T)-M*r)-p, with all symbols and parameter conditions explicit.
optional_stopping_handling: Pathwise equality of full stopped histories on an all-hidden-low event; hypergeometric averaging conditional on the entire labelled null transcript; Jensen only on the resulting exact E[b^T].
normalizer_and_target_access: Unknown normalizer; no target query except counted iid candidates; no prefix local probes; hard raw oracle values equal null raw values exactly on matched histories.
scope_limits: The adverse public q and Q vary with epsilon, as explicitly allowed by the uniform easy-family quantifiers.
Does not rule out savings for a fixed small finite support or restricted easy subclass.
Does not address richer target-evaluation or pre-prefix local-query interfaces.
Does not claim a new matching subsequent-time exponent for arbitrary random prefixes.
No historical-priority, owner-acceptance, or practical-speedup assertion.
proof_status: Complete analytic proof written in RESULT.txt; no numerical validation needed or claimed; no independent reviewer used within this bounded trial.
actual_failed_routes_preserved: ATTEMPTS.txt records rejected direct reuse of the public three-state lower family and the endpoint-preserving bypass.
